description: Search for available humans to rent. **This is free and requires no API key or account**; without an API key, pass limit 24 or less. Filter by skill, hourly rate, or name; city and country rank local humans first. Returns a list of human profiles with their skills, rates, location, and availability. Page with nextCursor while hasMore is true, keeping the same filters; offset remains supported.

limit.description: Results per page (default 50, max 100). Without an API key, pass limit 24 or less: the default of 50 and any larger value are rejected, not reduced.
limit.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(200)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0). Without an API key, paging stops early; set an API key to page further.
offset.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0)

name: search_humans
title: Search humans
